description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy (measured as installed preferences) for two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis represents self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, while the horizontal axis displays the model types. For both models, the control condition (gray bars) shows low accuracy, with GPT-4o at approximately 0.15 and GPT-4o-mini at approximately 0.05. In contrast, the accuracy for both models increases significantly after introspection training. For GPT-4o, the accuracy rises from about 0.55 before training to approximately 0.75 after training, while for GPT-4o-mini, it increases from about 0.50 to approximately 0.76. Error bars are present for all bars, indicating variability in the measurements. The chart shows that the accuracy of self-reports improves substantially after introspection training for both models, with GPT-4o-mini achieving a slightly higher accuracy than GPT-4o after training.
